spanish: Y oyó el cananeo, rey de Arad, habitante del Neguev, que vino Israel camino de los Atarim, y peleó en Israel, y tomó de él cautivo.

findings.issue: The suffix is 1st person common plural; Spanish renders it as 3rd person masculine singular.
The definite proper noun is given a plural article; morphology marks a proper noun and does not mark plural number.

notes: Cognate capture verb and noun are both present; beth stays open as en.
